categories.main_business_segments: Lontrue Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: agricultural product processing and data center services. The agricultural segment focuses on processing and selling dried fruits, nuts, and fresh fruits, including raisins, fresh apples, pine nuts, and kernels, serving both domestic and international markets. The data center segment provides rack leasing services, mainly through its facility in Taiyuan, with over 1,400 racks rented out.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced dry and fresh cold chain shared technology to ensure product quality and extend storage life. It maintains strict food processing and testing procedures, adhering to certifications such as HACCP, ISO22000, BRCGS, KOSHER, HALAL, and GLOBAL GAP. Production is standardized and managed internally without outsourcing, ensuring quality control from raw material procurement to final product delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lontrue serves well-known domestic and international customers, including major snack and bakery brands such as ChaCha Group, Three Squirrels, Starbucks, and Haidilao. Its agricultural products are used as raw materials for baking and as snacks, with fresh fruit exports mainly targeting Southeast Asia, South Asia, and the Middle East. The data center business caters to clients requiring rack leasing services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in North China, East China, South China, Southwest China, Northeast China, Central China, and Northwest China regions. Internationally, it has a strong presence in European raisin markets and fresh fruit markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and the Middle East. The data center is located in Taiyuan, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lontrue operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the agricultural supply chain, focusing on processing raw agricultural products into dried fruits, nuts, and packaged fresh fruits. It controls the entire production process from raw material procurement (mainly from farmers and cooperatives) to processing, packaging, and sales. The data center business is a downstream service provider offering infrastructure leasing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company aims to strengthen its agricultural product processing business by expanding into the domestic baking market and pre-packaged food sector. It focuses on product innovation aligned with customer needs, enhancing quality and standardization. Lontrue plans to develop a comprehensive food supply platform, expand product categories and sales channels, and improve brand influence. Talent development, internal control, and governance improvements are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Lontrue generates revenue primarily through product sales of dried fruits, nuts, and fresh fruits, both domestically and internationally. The data center segment contributes revenue via fixed monthly rack leasing fees. The company also earns income from other business activities such as asset disposals and government subsidies, but these are minor compared to core product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lontrue positions itself as a leading agricultural product processor with strong brand recognition in European and Southeast Asian markets. It competes with other agricultural processors and food ingredient suppliers, leveraging its advanced cold chain technology and certifications to differentiate. The company is recognized as a provincial leading enterprise in agricultural industrialization and a model in agricultural product processing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lontrue reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 245.37 million, representing an 11.41% increase from 2023. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 36.44 million, an improvement compared to the previous year's larger loss. The company’s total assets reached RMB 727.52 million, with net assets of RMB 520.32 million, showing moderate growth. The company faces ongoing profitability challenges but is improving its financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lontrue emphasizes product quality, safety, stability, and standardization, supported by advanced cold chain technology and rigorous quality management systems. Its extensive certifications enable access to developed markets in Europe and the US. The company’s ability to control the supply chain from raw material sourcing to finished product delivery ensures consistent product quality, meeting the high standards of leading snack and baking brands. This comprehensive quality assurance and brand reputation constitute its core competitive advantage.
